event_description: State of disaster in eight counties for widespread flooding from heavy rain and thunderstorms
State disaster area declared in Clovis after the tornado of March 23, 2007
Lincoln and Otero counties declared disaster areas for the flooding of July 27, 2008
Disaster declared for flood damage from heavy rains in Socorro, Mora and McKinley counties, part of the Navajo Nation, Farmington and the Pueblo of Acoma
State of emergency for natural gas outages caused by extreme cold
Emergency declared throughout New Mexico due to the severe storms and flooding across the state in July
State of disaster declared statewide due to flooding from record rain
